item.title: Video Game Industry Responds to BioWare Shutting Down
item.description: Electronic Arts revealed on Wednesday that the legendary RPG studio BioWare is no more . The sudden shuttering wasn't exactly a surprise to onlookers — recent BioWare releases received mixed reviews and middling sales numbers — but deep down, many were hoping that the developer could find its footing again. Seemingly every gamer and industry worker of a certain era still has fond memories of surviving Mass Effect 2 's suicide mission, or romancing a character in Dragon Age: Origins .

item.title: Award-Winning Sci-Fi Author Reveals Role on Canceled Mass Effect
item.description: The fifth installment in BioWare's Mass Effect series was announced six years ago . But the game was still in early development by a small team, and we never got to know much about the game, including who was hired to work on it.

item.title: Dungeon Crawler Carl Is Officially Getting a New Release Next Year
item.description: Even if you haven't read any of the books, you've probably heard of Dungeon Crawler Carl at this point. The LitRPG series (a genre defined by its use of video game and tabletop RPG mechanics) by Matt Dinniman has become a cultural juggernaut, and it is only getting bigger. In addition to a television adaptation , Dungeon Crawler Carl is also being adapted into a comic book.

item.title: 'Mass Effect Universe' Trailer Leaks A Day After BioWare Shutters
item.description: After news of BioWare's closure broke , fans were confused: how could Mass Effect 5 reportedly still be in early development if it was announced five years ago, in 2020? The next day, a short clip apparently leaked, and it seems to answer the question of where Mass Effect 5' s development progress actually stood.

item.title: Superhero Workplace Comedy Hit 'Dispatch' Reveals Huge Update and New Platforms
item.description: It’s been a busy first year at the Superhero Dispatch Network, and Dispatch is celebrating with a whole lot of new content. AdHoc Studio’s hit narrative adventure is getting two new behind-the-scenes modes, a mobile release date, and more.

item.title: Winter Sotoyama region treasure hunt location in Forza Horizon 6
item.description: The winter Sotoyama region treasure hunt is one of the weekly activities in Forza Horizon 6 Series 6, "Horizon Meets." Whenever a new hunt begins, a box appears somewhere on the map and, to locate it, the only hints you have are the region's name and a picture. Completing this challenge helps you get closer to claiming the weekly and the Series cars.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Turns 2 of the Best Star Trek Episodes Into Sagas
item.description: Magic: The Gathering ’s Star Trek Universes Beyond set is drawing inspiration from across the sci-fi franchise’s 60 year history, including references to all of its shows and films. Some of the most iconic episodes are brought to life as sagas, like “The City on the Edge of Tomorrow” and “Amok Time” from the original 1960s series and “In the Pale Moonlight” from Deep Space Nine . Polygon can exclusively reveal nine new cards, including two sagas that spotlight Jean-Luc Picard and the best hours of Star Trek: The Next Generation .

item.title: Universes Beyond Is About to Ruin the best Magic: The Gathering Set of the Year
item.description: Being a Magic: The Gathering fan has become an intense hobby. While the beauty of Magic lies in its variety, as the game offers ample choice of formats and ways to play, the quick pace of new set releases has affected the Magic experience overall. One of the most obvious consequences is that Magic sets don't stay around as long as they used to: Marvel Super Heroes still felt new when Bilbo Baggins came strolling into the picture with The Hobbit 's release just seven weeks later.

item.title: New James Bond Recast Coming Soon With 'Final Auditions' Imminent
item.description: The hunt for the next James Bond is almost over. More than five years after Daniel Craig bowed out as Bond in Cary Joji Fukunaga's No Time to Die , another 007 is about to receive his license to kill. According to a new report, Amazon MGM Studios’ search for the new James Bond is entering its final phase, as the company holds its last round of auditions over the next week. These screen tests could begin as early as Friday and run through the next few days.

item.title: Carrie Officially Coming Back for Season 2 on Prime Video
item.description: After a chart-topping streaming debut on Prime Video, Mike Flanagan and Stephen King's television series Carrie is returning for season 2, Amazon MGM Studios confirmed Thursday in an official announcement. Flanagan and King are set to return for the second season of Carrie , which will send the psychokinetic high-schooler into uncharted territory, given how season 1 of the hit horror show ended .
